questions.question: A sum of Rs. 5,760 amounts to Rs. 7,200 in 4 years and to Rs. x in 12 years at a certain rate per cent per annum, when the interest is compounded yearly in both the cases. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Principal = Rs. 5760

Amount = Rs. 7200

Time = 4 years

**Formula used**

A = P(1 + r%)t

**Calculation**

7200 = 5760(1 +r%)⁴

⇒ 7200/5760 = (1 + r%)⁴ ---- (1)

let the Principal 5760 becomes x amount in 12 years.

then, x = 5760(1 + r%)¹²

⇒ x/5760 = [(1 + r%)⁴]³

⇒ x/5760 = (7200/5760)³ (from 1)

⇒ x = (7200 × 7200 × 7200 × 5760)/(5760 × 5760 × 5760)

⇒ x = 11,250

**∴ The value of x is 11,250**

questions.question: A sum of money was lent in two parts in the ratio 4 ∶ 5 for 4 years and 5 years respectively, both at the rate of 8% per annum simple interest. If the difference between the interests earned from the two parts is Rs.4680, then what was the total sum lent (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of sum of money = 4 : 5

T₁ = 4 years

T₂ = 5 years

Rate = 8%

Difference between the interests earned from the two parts = Rs. 4680

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the ratio of sum of money be 4x and 5x respectively

Total ratio of sum of money = (4x + 5x) = 9x

According to the question

SI on first part = (4x × 8 × 4)/100

⇒ 128x/100

SI on second part = (5x × 8 × 5)/100

⇒ 200x/100

Difference between the interests = (200x/100 – 128x/100)

⇒ 72x/100

Now,

⇒ 72x/100 = 4680

⇒ 72x = (4680 × 100)

⇒ 72x = 468000

⇒ x = (468000/72)

⇒ x = Rs. 6500

The total sum lent = 9x = Rs. (9 × 6500)

⇒ Rs. 58500

**∴ The required total sum lent is Rs. 58500**

questions.question: A certain sum is lent at 5% p.a. for 2 years, 9% p.a. for the next 3 years and 13% p.a. after 5 years. If the simple interest on the sum for a period of 10 years is Rs. 8,160, then the sum (in Rs.) is:

Rate of interest, r fir next 3 years = 9% p.a.

Rate of interest, r for next 5 years = 13% p.a.

**Formula used**

Simple Interest = (Principal × rate × time)over 100

**Calculation**

160 = (p × 2 × 5)over {100} + (P × 3 × 9)over100+ (P × 5 × 13)over 100

⇒ 8160 = 10Pover{100} + 27Pover100 + 65Pover100

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 17,200 is lent out at simple interest in two parts for two years at 8% and 10% p.a., respectively. If the total interest received after two years is Rs. 3,008, then the money lent at 8% rate is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 17,200

Rate = 8% and 10%

The total interest received after two years = Rs. 3,008

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the amount lent on 8% be x.

Then, the amount lent on 10% be (17,200 – x)

So, Interest on first part = (x × 8 × 2)/100

And, Interest on second part = [(17,200 – x) × 10 × 2/100]

Now,

⇒ (x × 8 × 2)/100 + [(17,200 – x) × 10 × 2/100] = 3,008

⇒ 16x/100 + 344,000 – 20x/100 = 3,008

⇒ (16x + 344,000 – 20x) = 3,008 × 100

⇒ (16x + 344,000 – 20x) = 300,800

⇒ (20x – 16x) = (344,000 – 300,800)

⇒ 4x = 43,200

⇒ x = (43,200/4)

⇒ x = Rs. 10,800

Now,

The money lent on 8% = x = Rs. 10,800

**∴ The required money is Rs. 10,800**

questions.question: If a certain sum at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years, then in how many years will it become 9 times, at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If a certain sum at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

Let the time be t

According to the question

We know that, 

Total Amount = P(1 + r/100)t

Now,

⇒ 3P = P(1 + r/100)⁴

⇒ 3 = (1 + r/100)⁴ ....(1)

Now,

After t years the sum becomes 9 times 

⇒ 9P = P(1 + r/100)t

⇒ 9 = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ 3² = (1 + r/100)t

Using equation (1), we get

⇒ (1 + r/100)⁸ = (1 + r/100)t

⇒ t = 8 years

**∴ The required time is 8 years**

questions.question: Divide Rs. 2,760 into two parts such that when these are invested for 2 and 4 years, respectively, at the rate of 5 % per annum simple interest, the amounts received are equal. What is the smaller part (in Rs.) invested?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total sum = Rs. 2760

Rate of interest = 5%

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Amount = P + S.I

Here,

P = Principal

T = time

R = rate

**Calculation:**

Let for the 1st part it is Rs. x

So, 2nd part = Rs. (2760 - x)

According to the question,

x + [(x × 2 × 5)/100] = (2760 - x) + [{(2760 - x) × 4 × 5}/100]

⇒ (100x + 10x)/100 = (276000 - 100x + 55200 - 20x)/100

⇒ 110x = 331200 - 120x

⇒ 230x = 331200

⇒ x = 331200/230

⇒ x = 1440

So, 1st part = Rs. 1440

So, 2nd part = 2760 - 1440

⇒ Rs. 1320

**∴ The small part (in Rs.) invested is 1320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the two parts are a and b

According to the question

⇒ a + (a × R × T)/100 = b + (b × R × T)/100

⇒ a + (a × 5 × 2)/100 = b + (b × 5 × 4)/100

⇒ a + a/10 = b + b/5

⇒ 11a/10 = 6b/5

⇒ 11a = 12b

⇒ a = 12 & b = 11

11 units + 12 units = 23 units = 2760

⇒ 1 unit = 2760/23 = 120

Second part = b = 11 units × 120 = 1320

∴ The small part (in Rs.) invested is 1320.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__** We have asked for the Amount not for interest,

Amount = Interest + principle
